tagline: Statistical genomics, spatial statistics, and Bayesian & network modeling for biomedical data.
bio: I'm Xiaohang — or David. I did my Statistics B.A. and Biostatistics M.S. at Boston University, and I work where statistics meets biology: epigenetic aging clocks, knowledge graphs for biomedical questions, spatial genomics, precision oncology. I also love music, movies, games, basketball and soccer. I love exploring new things — including making this website. (Though the website itself was written purely by Fable, not me.)
